method.name: PACTA-MSR
method.expanded_name: Paired Action-Contrast Transport Authority with Matched State Reveal
method.definition: Before branch-specific memory authority is assessed, a branch-blind controller obtains one read-only repository observation using the future task but no writer memory. The exact probe action and observation are frozen and injected identically into both success-writer and failure-writer decision contexts. PACTA then evaluates paired branch influence from this matched post-observation state.
method.writer_twins: Official ReasoningBank SUCCESSFUL_SI versus FAILED_SI applied to the exact same frozen native source trajectory.

state_reveal.execution: exact future SWE-bench image normalized to the frozen future base commit
state_reveal.output: one validated read-only shell command plus its exact environment observation

two_selector_shadow_ablation.G0: Original step-0 PACTA on the fresh pilot units.
two_selector_shadow_ablation.Gplus: PACTA-MSR from the exact same units after the matched state reveal.

mechanism_gate.interpretation: MSR must prospectively improve stable branch-specific transport relative to the step-0 selector before final method-effect measurement is opened.

final_arms.A0_NATIVE: raw factual branch memory at the matched revealed state
final_arms.A1_SCB_ALWAYS: state-conditioned binding always active at the matched revealed state
final_arms.A2_RATE_MATCHED_RANDOM: SCB enabled on exactly K units by a pre-shadow hash ranking
final_arms.A3_PACTA_MSR: SCB enabled on units opened by Gplus

pilot_effect_gate: positive D_select unit count > negative count

freshness.source_selection: one deterministic source/future pair per eligible repository after complete prior-task exclusion using new SHA salts
